_comment: FICTIONAL. Simulated Electoral Commission notices for tests and demos only. Not INEC, not a real body. Every URL is on the reserved .example domain; reviewers are sample names.

notices.title: Simulated Electoral Commission: voter registration deadline
notices.text: The Simulated Electoral Commission announces that voter registration closes on 14th November. Register only at https://register.sec.example. Registration is free.
